exposure: fresh transfer of blastocysts cultured from vitrified-thawed cleavage embryos (VTCE)
Fresh transfer of blastocysts cultured from vitrified-thawed cleavage embryos (VTCE)
finding: Transfer of blastocysts cultured from vitrified-thawed cleavage embryos (VTCE) resulted in a lower risk of early miscarriage and decreased fetal birth weight compared to conventional frozen-thawed blastocysts transfer (FBT), but a higher occurrence of cesarean section and shorter gestational age compared to fresh blastocysts transfer (FRBT).
mod_finding: VTCE blastocysts' transfer led to a higher occurrence of cesarean Section (88.89% versus 71.29%, P < 0.05) and a shorter gestational age (262.04 ± 14.99 days versus 268.06 ± 14.07, P < 0.05) compared to FRBT.
birth_weight: VTCE: 2611.90 ± 618.65 g, FBT: 2931.86 ± 546.52 g, FRBT: Not mentioned
